# Wharf 0.1.0 review

## Review scope

Validated the implementation against:

- `.github/tracking/2026-10-06-wharf-0.1.0-research.md`
- `.github/tracking/2026-10-06-wharf-0.1.0-plan.md`
- the Session 1 build and proof contract in `docs/wharf-sessions.md`

The initial review was read-only. Its release-blocking findings were returned
to implementation, fixed, and re-reviewed before release.

## Plan and requirement result

- Root module and Go 1.27 toolchain: accepted.
- Thin `cmd/wharf` boundary and internal package organization: accepted.
- Sole linker-overridable version source: accepted.
- Complete v1 command registration with explicit placeholders: accepted.
- Semver-only version paths: accepted.
- Help and completion foundations: accepted.
- Explicit flag-over-environment-over-default configuration: accepted.
- Tab-delimited and JSON console formats: accepted.
- Separate always-JSON durable logger API: accepted.
- Quiet mode and four verbosity thresholds: accepted.
- Typed secret attributes and redaction hook: accepted as the partial Session 1
  foundation; full secret-safety acceptance remains deferred to Session 8.
- Stable exit-code boundary and explicit unknown-input handling: accepted.
- Documented one-command validation workflow: accepted.

## Findings

No unresolved implementation defects or evidence gaps remain for the 0.1.0
session scope.

The first review pass found defects in logger integration, help validation and
write errors, subprocess environment isolation, and version consistency. They
returned to implementation, received focused regression tests, and passed the
complete validation workflow before this final review.
